name: Dwarf-Blooded Aasimar (Forgekin Aasimar Variant)

body:
While not all aasimars are born of humans, rarely does an aasimar’s mortal parentage make a difference. Sometimes, however, an aasimar’s dwarven blood will so strongly dominate that it becomes almost more important than the celestial component of the aasimar’s heritage.

Forgekins appear to have beards made of spun gold or living flame, or skin of burnished brass or polished steel, and their eyes glitter like sparkling jewels. They use the height, weight, and age charts for dwarves instead of those normally used for aasimars. Most forgekins are Lawful Good, and are dedicated members of the dwarven communities that raised them.

Core Traits

As a forgekin, you gain the following alternate traits:

Alternate Ability Scores You gain +2 Con and +2 Int.
Alternate Spell-Like Ability You gain groundswell as a spell-like ability.
Dwarf Traits You gain the dwarf’s hardy, stability, and stonecunning species traits. These traits replace celestial resistances and skilled.
